L1473@P19: Utilization Review Standards
L1474@P19: In this resubmitted regulatory action, the Division
L1475@P19: updates its administrative rules related to utilization
L1476@P19: review standards. The updates address the reporting
L1477@P19: duties of the primary treating physician, procedures
L1478@P19: for independent medical review, investigation procedures for utilization review violations, and procedures
L1479@P19: to change the primary treating physician. In addition,
L1480@P19: this regulatory action adds penalties for utilization review and independent medical review violations.
L1481@P19: Title 08
L1482@P19: Adopt: 9792.7.1, 9792.9. 7, 9792.9.8

L1492@P19: Veterinary Medical Board
L1493@P19: File # 2025–1112–01
L1494@P19: Minimum Standards for Alternate Veterinary
L1495@P19: Premises
L1496@P19: This rulemaking action by the Veterinary Medical
L1497@P19: Board consolidates minimum veterinary premises requirements into one section and provides new categories of exemptions from those minimum requirements.
L1498@P19: Additionally, the action removes related building standards as these are located in California Code of Regulations, title 24, section 1251. This is a resubmittal of
L1499@P19: withdrawn OAL File Number 2025–0815–02S.

L1515@P20: Actions section of the Notice Register published on
L1516@P20: the first Friday more than nine days after the date filed.
